name: Crystal Matrix Limited
india_angle: Crystal Matrix Ltd is establishing India's first GaN Fab and MicroLED ecosystem under the India Semiconductor Mission at Dholera Special Investment Region.
summary: Crystal Matrix Limited is building a state-of-the-art compound semiconductor fab in India to manufacture GaN epitaxy wafers and Mini/Micro-LED display panels. This initiative positions the company as a key player in advanced display and semiconductor technologies, contributing to India's strategic semiconductor mission.
